{{Quote|We are getting reports that the thugs have already shipped off some things they found at the site. You need to track them down and retrieve what's ours. One is at the starport in Nashal and the other is at what appears to be a Rebel weapon depot.|[[Omkoo]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GR">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Grave Robbers|Talus}}</ref>}}
The '''Nashal Starport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located in the city of [[Nashal]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="SWG" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer working for the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Omkoo]] fought several [[TTLP soldiers]] in the spaceport to retrieve old artifacts stolen from an [[Aqualish gravesite]].<ref name="SWG:GR" />
